name: Andrés
headline: Turn Millicom’s usage data into offers that stay.
saw: Any operator at your scale tends to sell the same plans and offers to every customer who sees them, so a long-standing subscriber and someone who is just browsing get the same message.

The signal you already own is what customers use, pause, top up and stop using, and it sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives. That is where the next upgrade and the next cancellation first show up.
Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are usually built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from usage drops, plan changes and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each customer and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next plan when it fits
cases.text: Next best plan or add-on per customer, triggered by what they actually use. No more blanket upgrade messages to people already on the right plan.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every customer using the service
cases.text: Personal content and usage nudges across every channel, so each customer has a reason to come back this week. Engagement is tracked per customer, not per campaign.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
